reasons.action: The brief explicitly asks that the man speak in the corridor, an intelligible requested vocal performance; that performed behavior is a request-level instruction and outranks any static source pose.
reasons.medium: The medium decision pins the rendering medium to the request with no governing visual reference; the sole supplied asset is an audio clip used for voice timbre, which has no authority over rendering process or style.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference is present and no wardrobe-bearing image supplies observed clothes, so the figure's clothing resolves under the request alone rather than any reference.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference or illuminated-scene reference exists; the corridor location and time-of-day implications in the brief are not instructions about the light, so lighting remains request-governed.
reasons.framing: No visual reference and no explicit shot scale, viewpoint or camera movement are supplied — the 16:9 canvas ratio and being in a corridor are not composition instructions — so framing is request-governed.
reasons.palette: No visual reference supplies observed color or tonal grading, and no explicit grade is described, leaving palette under request governance.
